authorization_source: Project owner instructed continuation after accepting the progress plan; Phase 1 is the planned audit of task definition and source roles.
purpose: Determine whether the pooled Mendeley binary source labels are semantically aligned with investment-scam content detection, and assign research roles to each source without changing labels, partitions, model configuration, or data eligibility.

official_source_statement.declared_scope: Five public groups covering phishing text, spam email, fake-profile posts, Twitter bot-detection records, and finance-related social-media data were harmonized into a common binary schema and filtered for investment relevance.
official_source_statement.declared_label_limit: Labels represent harmonized deceptive or suspicious behaviour and are not verified investment-scam ground truth for every record.

audit_dimensions: raw label meaning versus verified investment-scam status
whether the requested target is identifiable from text alone
transfer relevance to evidence-backed external website cases
permitted role in future train, validation, test, auxiliary, or reference workflows
allowed_evidence: hash-pinned local registries and their already-opened aggregate metrics
prohibited_operations: read new row-level validation or test text
fit, refit, score, or select any model
change any source label, split, training eligibility, threshold, or model configuration
silently remove twitter_bot_detection or any other source from an existing benchmark
reuse an opened external cohort for model selection
next_gate: Publish a source-role recommendation and task-definition decision. Any implementation that changes the training corpus requires a separate owner-visible protocol before data construction or modeling.
